TalonFX - Enum constant in enum class frc.lib.NinjasLib.controllers.Controller.ControllerType
 
TalonFXController - Class in frc.lib.NinjasLib.controllers
Controller implementation that wraps a CTRE TalonFX (Falcon 500/Kraken X60) motor controller via the Phoenix 6 API.
TalonFXController(RealControllerConstants) - Constructor for class frc.lib.NinjasLib.controllers.TalonFXController
Constructs and applies a full TalonFXConfiguration to the main TalonFX - soft limits, motor output inversion/neutral mode, Motion Magic constraints, stator/supply current limits, Slot0 PIDF/gravity gains, and the feedback source (either the internal rotor, scaled by the gear ratio/conversion factor, or a remote CANcoder fused/synced per RealControllerConstants.CANCoder.mode) - then constructs each follower TalonFX to follow it.
TalonSRX - Enum constant in enum class frc.lib.NinjasLib.controllers.Controller.ControllerType
 
TalonSRXController - Class in frc.lib.NinjasLib.controllers
Controller implementation that wraps a CTRE TalonSRX motor controller via the legacy Phoenix 5 API.
TalonSRXController(RealControllerConstants) - Constructor for class frc.lib.NinjasLib.controllers.TalonSRXController
Factory-resets and configures the main TalonSRX (inversion, peak current limit, PID gains, Motion Magic cruise velocity/acceleration, and soft limits), then factory-resets and configures each follower TalonSRX to follow it.
